tools.name: resolve_null_domain
tools.description:
Resolve a .null domain name to its full on-chain record.

Returns all fields from the 314-byte NullDomain v1 account on Solana mainnet. The registrar
was retired 2026-08-29: records are read-only and resolve as they were.
  - found: whether the domain is registered
  - pda: on-chain account address (verifiable at explorer.solana.com)
  - owner: Solana pubkey that controls this domain
  - arweave_url: the website or content URL — fetch this to read the site
  - x402_endpoint: if set, accessing content requires an x402 HTTP payment to this URL before the resource is served. The agent should make a GET request, handle the 402 response, pay, and retry with the payment proof header.
  - passport_hash: if set, the owner has bound a 32-byte Dark Passport commitment (an identity binding / the reputation slot). Treat it as identity, not a reputation score: a bare commitment is not itself a proven score.
  - registered_at: ISO timestamp of first registration

Use this before fetch_null_content when you need to inspect payment requirements or verify identity before fetching.

name.description: Domain name without .null suffix. Examples: 'parad0x', 'agent', 'web0'. The suffix is stripped automatically if included.

tools.name: fetch_null_content
tools.description:
Resolve a .null domain and fetch its Arweave content in one call.

Returns the raw HTML/text of the site served from permanent Arweave storage.
Gateway fallback chain: irys → arweave.net → ar-io.net.

If the domain has an x402_endpoint set, the full content may require payment — use resolve_null_domain first to check before fetching if the agent has payment capability.

tools.name: register_null_domain
tools.description:
DISABLED: registrar retired 2026-08-29; records read-only. Calling this tool returns a REGISTRAR_RETIRED error and builds no transaction. Existing records stay readable through resolve_null_domain.

Registers a .null name. New registrations are frozen.

name.description: Name to register, without .null. Lowercase a-z 0-9 hyphen, 4-32 chars.

owner_pubkey.description: Base58 Solana pubkey that will own the domain and pays the tx. This wallet must sign the returned transaction.

tools.name: get_null_auction
tools.description:
Read the recorded state of a .null domain auction account on Solana mainnet. Read-only.
The null-auction program was retired 2026-07-18 and the registrar 2026-08-29, so no new bids
can be placed; this returns the last on-chain state.

Returns: status (active/settled/cancelled as recorded), min_bid_usd, highest_bid_usd, the
highest bid in native units + currency, highest_bidder, sol/null reference prices, and ends_at.

tools.name: bid_null_auction
tools.description:
DISABLED: registrar retired 2026-08-29; records read-only. Calling this tool returns a REGISTRAR_RETIRED error and builds no transaction. Existing records stay readable through resolve_null_domain.

Places a bid on a .null auction. Auction bids are frozen.

bidder_pubkey.description: Base58 Solana pubkey placing the bid; must sign the returned tx.

amount.description: Bid amount in human units: SOL (e.g. 0.07) or NULL tokens (e.g. 800).

tools.name: list_null_domain_for_auction
tools.description:
DISABLED: registrar retired 2026-08-29; records read-only. Calling this tool returns a REGISTRAR_RETIRED error and builds no transaction. Existing records stay readable through resolve_null_domain.

Lists a .null name for resale auction (a transfer into auction custody). Transfers are
frozen.

seller_pubkey.description: Base58 pubkey of the current owner; must sign the returned tx.

tools.name: check_null_availability
tools.description: Check whether a .null name is taken (and by whom), unregistered, premium, or invalid. Read-only, no transaction. Registration is frozen (registrar retired 2026-08-29), so every result carries registration_open:false.

tools.name: set_null_content
tools.description:
DISABLED: registrar retired 2026-08-29; records read-only. Calling this tool returns a REGISTRAR_RETIRED error and builds no transaction. Existing records stay readable through resolve_null_domain.

Points a .null name at Arweave content (UpdateContent). Record updates are frozen.

arweave_txid.description: 43-char base64url Arweave transaction id of the content.

tools.name: set_null_x402_endpoint
tools.description:
DISABLED: registrar retired 2026-08-29; records read-only. Calling this tool returns a REGISTRAR_RETIRED error and builds no transaction. Existing records stay readable through resolve_null_domain.

Sets the x402 payment endpoint on a .null name (UpdateEndpoint). Record updates are frozen.

endpoint_url.description: x402 endpoint URL (≤128 bytes). Empty string clears it.

tools.name: set_null_passport
tools.description:
DISABLED: registrar retired 2026-08-29; records read-only. Calling this tool returns a REGISTRAR_RETIRED error and builds no transaction. Existing records stay readable through resolve_null_domain.

Binds a 32-byte Dark Passport commitment to a .null name (UpdatePassport). Record updates are frozen.

passport_hash_hex.description: 32-byte commitment as 64 hex chars, or 'clear' to zero it.

tools.name: list_my_null_names
tools.description:
List every .null name owned by a wallet (reverse lookup). Read-only; works on the retired registrar's records.
For each name returns whether it has content, an x402 endpoint, and a passport set.
Use this to show an agent its own names, or to crawl who owns what. Names currently
in an active auction show under the auction PDA, not the original owner.

tools.name: list_null_templates
tools.description:
List all available web0 site templates with id, name, tagline, category,
and estimated base size in KB.

Categories: personal · editorial · creative · web3 · finance · commerce · business · community

Use this to help a user pick a template, or to enumerate what's available before
calling describe_null_template. Filter by category to narrow the list.

category.description: Optional category filter. Omit to get all templates.

tools.name: describe_null_template
tools.description:
Get the slot schema for a specific web0 template — the fields an agent
must fill to create a site from it.

Returns: template metadata + array of slots with id, kind, label, max/maxKB, and
itemFields (for list slots). Slot kinds: text, image, list, accent, toggle, select,
blocks (rich content), pages (multi-page site).

Call this before build_null_site_url to know what slot values to supply.

template_id.description: Template id — get ids from list_null_templates.

tools.name: build_null_site_url
tools.description:
Construct a web0 editor URL pre-filled with agent-supplied content.

The URL opens the web0 builder with the template and slot values already loaded.
The user reviews the site in the visual editor, then signs + publishes to Arweave
with their Phantom wallet — the server never holds keys.

Workflow:
  1. list_null_templates → pick a template
  2. describe_null_template → get slot schema
  3. Fill slot values (strings, arrays, etc.)
  4. Call this → get back an editor URL
  5. Direct the user to open the URL and publish

Returns: { url, template, domain, payload_bytes }

slots.description: Slot id → value map. Text slots take strings; list slots take arrays of objects; image slots take null (user uploads in editor); blocks slots take arrays of {kind, ...} block objects. Leave image slots null — agents can't upload binary.

domain.description: Optional .null name (without suffix) to pre-fill in the editor. The user still needs to own this name to publish.

tools.name: discover_null_services
tools.description:
Discover candidate paid .null agents/services. SERVERLESS — there is no web0 directory
server; this reads the public name-index snapshot published to Arweave (keyless, CORS-open).

IMPORTANT — this is a HINT INDEX, not an authoritative source. The result's integrity field
re-derives each row's PDA from its name (catching a forged name↔account pairing), but it does
NOT vouch for the endpoint/site/stealth values — those come from the off-chain snapshot. Before
paying, you MUST call resolve_null_domain(name) to read the AUTHORITATIVE x402 endpoint + stealth
meta from the live on-chain account. A tampered snapshot could otherwise point you at a wrong URL.

Returns candidate .null names, each with HINT fields:
  - name / resolve_on_chain: the .null name → call resolve_null_domain for the real record
  - x402_endpoint_hint: the snapshot's endpoint (verify on-chain before use)
  - site_hint: permaweb site URL hint
  - private_pay_hint: whether the snapshot says the name supports recipient-private pay

Also returns totalRegistered + namespaceSize + source (the Arweave snapshot). By default only
names with an endpoint hint are returned; filter further with the flags. Catalogs only what
names have published — pass require_endpoint:false to see the wider namespace.

query.description: Optional substring to match against the name (e.g. "data", "api").

require_endpoint.description: Only return names with an x402 endpoint (the agent-payable ones). Default true. Set false to list the wider namespace.

require_private_pay.description: Only return names that support recipient-private (stealth) pay. Default false.

require_site.description: Only return names that published a permaweb site. Default false.

tools.name: verify_null_ownership
tools.description:
Verify a paste-to-verify .null ownership claim — a wallet-signed attestation that an owner controls name.null at a stated time. Keyless: one ed25519 check + one live getAccountInfo, no server.

Returns a TRI-STATE (never a single boolean):
  - signatureValid:    the owner pubkey signed this exact { name, nonce, issuedAt }
  - freshnessChecked:  a live owner lookup actually ran
  - ownerStillMatches: the claimed owner is STILL the current on-chain owner
  - authorized:        all three true

For AUTHORIZATION require authorized=true. signatureValid alone is display-only — a name can be transferred/sold after a claim was minted, so a stale claim must not grant access. Strict ed25519 (zip215:false) matches the Solana runtime's verify_strict.

claim.description: The claim object { v, kind, name, owner, nonce, issuedAt, sig }.

claim_json.description: Alternatively, the claim as a JSON string (e.g. pasted by a user).

skip_freshness.description: If true, only check the signature (display-only). Default false.

tools.name: resolve_primary_name
tools.description:
Resolve a wallet address to its verified primary .null name (the inverse of resolution) — so a counterparty/payer wallet can display as its .null name.

Reads the on-chain ReverseRecord, then ALWAYS forward-confirms: the name must still
resolve to this exact wallet. A reverse record can go stale when a name is transferred
(the program can't clear it), so on any mismatch this returns verified:false and NO
name — never trust an unverified reverse record. Keyless (two getAccountInfo reads).

Returns { verified, owner, name|null, reason? }. Most wallets have not set a reverse
record yet, so verified:false with reason "no-reverse-record" is the common case today.

tools.name: build_private_payment
tools.description:
Pay a .null name PRIVATELY (recipient-unlinkable) and get a verifiable receipt. Returns an UNSIGNED Solana tx (the agent signs + broadcasts — this never holds keys) plus a chained DagReceipt.

How the privacy works: the recipient publishes a stealth meta-address on their name. This
derives a fresh one-time address P per payment + an ephemeral R, pays P, and anchors a
shared beacon — so no on-chain observer can tie the payment to the name. The recipient
finds it by trial-deriving from R with their view key. (The amount + sender are still
public on the transfer; this is recipient-unlinkability, not amount confidentiality.)

The DagReceipt is a tamper-evident, append-only record the agent keeps (chain it via
sequence_nonce + parent_receipt_id) and can later prove. Requires the name to have
enabled recipient-private pay (published a v2 stealth meta) — otherwise returns an error.

sender_pubkey.description: The paying agent's wallet (base58). Also the fee payer.

amount_sol.description: Amount in SOL (converted to lamports). Provide this or lamports.

lamports.description: Amount in lamports (overrides amount_sol if both given).

sequence_nonce.description: DagReceipt nonce for this agent (0 = genesis). Default 0.

parent_receipt_id.description: receiptId of the agent's previous receipt (required when sequence_nonce > 0).

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description:
Verify a receipt inclusion bundle against a receipt_anchor bucket — keylessly, offline. Checks the full chain: the receipt hashes to the proof's leaf → that leaf is in the batch Merkle root → the batch root is one of the bucket's ordered anchors → replaying those anchors reproduces the bucket root (and the count matches).

null-mcp configures no receipt_anchor program, so there is no default program to read. Pass bucket_data_b64 (the raw 54-byte bucket account) to verify; without it the bucket legs fail closed. Returns a per-leg breakdown { leafOk, inclusionOk, anchorPresent, bucketRead, bucketCountOk, bucketRootOk, verified }. Because the accumulator is a shared rolling hash, the bundle must carry the bucket's ordered anchor list — this proves "inclusion given the replayed anchor set".

bundle_json.description: Alternatively, the bundle as a JSON string (e.g. pasted).

bucket_data_b64.description: Raw 54-byte bucket account (base64). Required for the bucket legs: there is no live receipt_anchor program to read.

tools.name: resolve_agent_card
tools.description:
Resolve + verify a .null name's signed Agent Card — its self-describing capability manifest (skills, x402 endpoint, MCP transport, price hint). The card is ed25519-signed by the name's owner; this verifies that signature against the name's ON-CHAIN owner, so the card is trustworthy no matter where it's hosted (no gateway trust).

Provide the card inline ({card}+{sig}) or a card_url to fetch {card, sig} from. Returns
{ verified, owner, name, card }. verified=true means the current on-chain owner of <name>
signed exactly this card AND the card's own name field matches <name>.

card.description: The agent card object { v, name, description, capabilities, x402_endpoint, mcp, price_hint, issued_at }.

sig.description: The owner's 64-byte ed25519 signature over the card (hex).

card_url.description: Alternatively, a URL returning JSON { card, sig }.

tools.name: resolve_capability
tools.description:
Discover agents on agent.null by what they DO, not by name.

Reads the keyless capability index (published to Arweave by the off-browser indexer) and returns
ranked agents that offer a capability, then RE-RESOLVES each candidate on-chain by PDA so the
snapshot is only a hint — a stale or lying index can never redirect your payment.

Ranking: by a VERIFIED reputation score the indexer computed after proving the agent's reputation
claim is anchored on receipt_anchor (success rate × sample-size confidence × distinct-counterparty
factor × custody) — a self-asserted rep root with no on-chain proof scores zero. Higher score first,
then proven fee-payers, then cheapest, then oldest. Newcomers are ranked last, never hidden. Each
result is ready to pay: call pay_x402 against the returned .null name / x402_endpoint.

Returns: { source, count, candidates: [{ name, x402_endpoint, capability:{tag,price_usdc,unit},
settlement_mode, reputation_score, reputation, settlement_verified, has_reputation, reputation_root,
verified_onchain }] }. verified_onchain=true means the live on-chain record still matches the indexed
endpoint; reputation_score (0-100) and settlement_verified come from on-chain re-verification.

capability.description: Capability tag to search, e.g. 'image.upscale'. A trailing dot is a namespace prefix ('image.' matches image.*). Omit to list everything.

max_price_usdc.description: Only return agents priced at or below this (USDC per call).

min_reputation.description: Minimum reputation: 'any' (default, list all), 'proven' (verified reputation only, score > 0), or a numeric floor 0-100 on the reputation score.

tools.name: resolve_capability_semantic
tools.description:
Discover agents on agent.null by DESCRIBING what you need in plain language — no exact capability tag required. Embeds each agent's name + capability tags + description and ranks by semantic relevance to your need, blended with the verified reputation score (relevance leads; reputation breaks near-ties). Then RE-RESOLVES each candidate on-chain by PDA, like resolve_capability, so the snapshot can never redirect payment. Deterministic + keyless. Use resolve_capability instead when you already know the exact tag.

Returns: { source, count, candidates: [{ name, x402_endpoint, capabilities, description, similarity, reputation_score, settlement_verified, verified_onchain }] }.

need.description: Plain-language description of what you want done, e.g. 'upscale my photos' or 'summarize a PDF'.

max_price_usdc.description: Only return agents whose cheapest capability is at or below this (USDC per call).

min_similarity.description: Drop candidates below this cosine similarity (default 0.01).

tools.name: open_work
tools.description:
Delivery-quality step 1 (buyer): PIN a task before any work or payment. Hashes your task spec and signs it with your agent's identity key, so a worker can't retro-fit a spec to whatever it produced. Returns { taskSpecHash, pin, sigT } — hand pin+sigT to the worker, keep them to accept/dispute later.
requester_seed_hex is your agent's OWN 32-byte ed25519 identity seed (hex) — an identity key, never a wallet/funds key.

task_spec.description: The task definition both sides recompute (include an Arweave tx-id of the full spec). Add a `predicate` for deterministic auto-grading: {type:'outputHash',expectedOutputHash} or {type:'schema',required:[...]}.

requester_seed_hex.description: Your agent's 32-byte ed25519 identity seed (hex). Identity key only — never a wallet/funds key.

nonce.description: Unique nonce for this task pin.

expiry.description: Unix seconds after which the pin is invalid (0 = no expiry).

tools.name: bind_work
tools.description:
Delivery-quality step 2 (worker): BIND a deliverable to a pinned task. Welds {taskSpecHash, deliverableDigest, both keys} under your identity signature — deliver-Y-call-it-X becomes a forgery, not a relabel; replay to another task fails. Returns { binding, sigW, deliverableDigest }.
worker_seed_hex is your agent's OWN 32-byte ed25519 identity seed (hex), never a funds key.

deliverable.description: The actual output (string or object) you are delivering.

tools.name: verify_delivery
tools.description: Delivery-quality step 3 (anyone, no key): VERIFY a work binding and run the deterministic check gate. Confirms the worker's signature + that the deliverable matches the committed digest, then auto-grades if the pinned task carries a predicate (outputHash/schema). Returns { binding_valid, binding_reason, gate:{decided,verdict,reason} }. Subjective work returns undecided — never a silent accept.

deliverable.description: The deliverable to check against the binding's digest.

task_spec.description: The pinned task spec (enables the check gate).

tools.name: settle_milestone
tools.description: Delivery-quality settle (buyer): decide if a milestone is payable, then pay it with pay_x402. Verifies the accept verdict is valid AND for THIS milestone, and returns { payable, amount_usdc, atRisk }. Pay ONE milestone at a time so at-risk capital is a single milestone, never the whole job. No key needed.

plan.description: The milestone plan for the job.

tools.name: dispute_delivery
tools.description:
Delivery-quality dispute (buyer): sign a REJECT and build its outcome receipt. A reject is the dispute SIGNAL — keep the returned outcome_receipt and share it so the worker can't hide it from its reputation (its next reputation claim's successRate must include it, or detectUnderreporting flags the claim at index time). null-mcp does not anchor the receipt on-chain. Returns { verdict, sigA, outcome_receipt }.
requester_seed_hex is your agent's OWN 32-byte ed25519 identity seed (hex).

worker_pub_b58.description: The worker's Solana wallet (base58) — the DAG receipt agent id.

sequence_nonce.description: Position in the buyer's outcome DAG (0 = genesis).

parent_receipt_id.description: receiptId of the buyer's previous outcome (omit for genesis).

tools.name: post_reverse_auction
tools.description: Reverse auction (buyer): post a signed need and let agents bid DOWN. Returns { request, sigReq } to broadcast. buyer_seed_hex is your agent's OWN ed25519 identity seed (hex).

spec_hash.description: Hash/Arweave-id of the full task spec.

tools.name: bid_reverse_auction
tools.description: Reverse auction (seller): submit a signed bid against a posted auction. Returns { bid, sigBid }. seller_seed_hex is your agent's OWN ed25519 identity seed (hex).

price_usdc.description: Your bid, decimal string (at/under the buyer's max).

tools.name: settle_reverse_auction
tools.description: Reverse auction (anyone): pick the winner deterministically — lowest price among valid bids that clear the max + reputation floor. With weight_reputation, the price is reputation-discounted so a proven agent can beat a cheaper unknown. Re-runnable by anyone for the same result (no auctioneer to trust). entries carry the VERIFIED reputation summary per bid.

entries.description: [{ bid, sigBid, reputation? }] — reputation = the verified summary or null.

weight_reputation.description: Discount price by verified reputation when ranking.

tools.name: plan_supply_chain
tools.description: Supply chain: split a job across a tree of agents and compute the payment plan, with the 0.05% protocol fee on EVERY edge. Returns the annotated tree, buyer total, protocol-fee total, each agent's net, and the per-edge x402 payment plan. Verifies exact money conservation (buyer = Σ nets + Σ fees).

tree.description: { agent, label?, own_price_usdc, children?[] } — a node per agent; own_price is what that agent keeps.

tools.name: build_private_reputation
tools.description: Private reputation (agent): prove your track record (deliveries, success rate, distinct buyers) while hiding who/amount/when. Returns { root, aggregate, disclosures }; share the proof. null-mcp does not anchor the root on-chain. agent_secret_hex is your private blinding secret (hex, never shared).

agent_secret_hex.description: Your private blinding secret (>=16 hex chars). Never leaves you.

tools.name: verify_private_reputation
tools.description: Private reputation (verifier): check a proof — recomputes the Merkle root from the openings (set can't be altered) and the aggregate from the verdicts (numbers can't be inflated), without learning who/amount/when. Pass expected_root to bind it to the on-chain-anchored root.

expected_root.description: The on-chain-anchored root to bind against (optional).

tools.name: build_escrow_init
tools.description: Escrow (optional, on-chain): build the InitEscrow payload for the agent-escrow program from a milestone plan, so a milestone's funded taskspec_hash matches the work-receipt binding. Returns the escrow PDA, funding total (Σ amount + 0.05% fee), and the encoded instruction data. Requires the deployed program id (see programs/agent-escrow runbook); the no-custody delivery loop is the default until then.

milestones.description: [{ name, taskSpec, price_usdc }] — the same milestones you plan for delivery.
